nodes: Annual leave (LEAVE-7.3): full-time employees accrue 22 days per year. Up to 15 unused days may
carry over to the next calendar year; the remainder expires.
Sick leave: employees report absence before 09:00 through the attendance portal. Medical certificates
are required beyond two consecutive days.
Remote work policy (RW-2): up to three remote days per week with manager approval. Fully remote
assignments require an HR exception record.
